name: Avatar-enabled Onboarding
tagline: Deliver approved, accessible avatar-led onboarding with accountable human oversight.
customer_outcome: New employees receive a clear, inclusive onboarding experience while owners can trace each published claim to approved content, human approvals, and operational evidence.
decision_prompts: Which onboarding moment, cohort, locale, and channel should the pilot serve first?
Which approved sources and named owners may support the script, and when do they expire?
Who must approve factual accuracy, legal/compliance implications, brand, and publication?
Which vendor or platform best meets consent, privacy, accessibility, language, audit, and exit requirements?
How will the experience disclose avatar or AI assistance, provide human help, and avoid deceptive representation?
Which feedback and operational measures will determine whether to iterate, scale, pause, or withdraw?

lessons.title: Draft a grounded script and storyboard
Run approval and select delivery options
